lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Alright, quiet down! Duke Prospero's Royal Ball starts right now!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Scan in at the gate, you're on Prince Hamlet's council tonight.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: This is Prince Hamlet. We mapped his entire brain, all hundred and sixty six thousand neurons of it.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: You're the Helmsman. Left and right, that's all you.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: You're the Liftmaster. Up and down are yours.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: You're the Wingmaster. Forward's your job, don't forget the brakes.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: You're the Seer. Only one who can see the Princess, and the Giant. So talk.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Behold Prince Hamlet, the first prince whose entire mind has been mapped. Tonight, you four fly him.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Princess Miranda. Clever, kind, and perfectly able to choose her own future.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Duke Prospero, her father. Very hard to impress, and surprisingly good at throwing things.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: And I am Clown, the court jester. I tell the story. Occasionally, I help.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Lord Tinman. Polished armour, perfect manners, and no heart whatsoever.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Count Rutabaga. He is courting someone. He simply cannot remember whom.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Sir Cheapdate. Half a grape, and he is everyone's best friend.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: And the Giant. A human with a swatter. Do not be where it lands.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: And you, his council! Left and right, up and down, forward and back. And the Seer, who senses what nobody else can.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: We need four grapes for the banquet. Four of you, four grapes. Should be easy.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Wingmaster, ease forward. Let go to slow down. It's a grape, not a getaway.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Helmsman, left and right. Small taps, we're picking grapes, not storming a castle.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Liftmaster, up to grab it, down to drop it in. Try not to lose the crown.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: All together now. Slow down before the turn, that cup's taken enough hits today.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Seer, Princess Miranda's near the cup somewhere. Find her and call it out.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Hello, Hamlet. Your Seer can find me. The rest of you would do well to listen to them.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: All four delivered! Not bad, for a job that's mostly grape juice now.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Four grapes, all in one piece. Father might even be impressed. Eventually.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Tonight's the night. Duke Prospero announces Prince Hamlet and Princess Miranda's engagement. But first... one tiny errand.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Four grapes, delivered, and not one spilled.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Perfectly steady... oh no.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Purple stains on your lips? Stumbling by the banquet cup, this morning of all mornings? Hamlet!

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: It was only a landing accident, Your Grace. A messy one, but an accident all the same.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Tonight of all nights I must trust you beside my daughter, and you cannot even arrive at breakfast steady on your feet?

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: I have not touched a drop, Your Grace! Ask my council, they were with me the whole time!

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Then prove it some other way, for right now you show me nothing but the opposite. The announcement is suspended, until you do.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Father, please, at least let him explain.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Stay outside, until you can hold yourself together.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: There, a window. Come, council, we may still set this right.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Locked out of your own betrothal, Prince Hamlet? How very becoming of a future king.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: My heart would go out to you, if I had one to spare. A family trait, I am told.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: This is my window, so we shall do this my way. Answer correctly, and you get pear nectar. Answer wrongly, and you may have more of whatever you have clearly already been drinking.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Here is your question, little prince. Does alcohol make one's balance and coordination... A, worse. Or B, sharper?

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Council... a little help, please.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Take your time. I have nowhere better to be, apparently.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: The answer is A. Alcohol interferes with the exact brain functions used for balance and coordinated movement.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Correct. How inconvenient. Pear nectar, as promised.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Wrong. Utterly wrong. The grape cordial, then, as agreed.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Do try not to fall to pieces before you arrive, Prince Hamlet. Princess Miranda dislikes a scene. I would not know; I feel very little, one way or the other.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: A fine inspection of the stonework. Now, let us try the opening.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Oh. You again. Or is it someone else? It hardly matters, you all look equally troublesome to me tonight.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Are you here for Princess Miranda? So is everyone, apparently, myself included, and I find it rather tiresome to keep explaining that.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: I wrote myself a question, so I would remember which drink goes to whom. Whom proved difficult to spell, but no matter. Answer it, and be quick about it.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Count Rutabaga, we really do need the stairs.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Yes, yes, the stairs. One question, and they are entirely yours, Prince Hamlet. Do stop hovering.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Can heavy drinking interfere with forming new memories? A, no. B, yes. Whoever wrote this has dreadful handwriting. Oh. That would be me.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: It is B. Alcohol can disrupt the forming of new memories. It does not erase the old ones, though. I have checked. More than once. For reasons I would rather not discuss.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Correct. New memories, yes, that was the important part. Pear nectar, then, for the one of us who remembered anything at all tonight.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Wrong! I had a rather cutting remark prepared for this moment, and now I cannot recall it. How fitting. The purple one, then, and good riddance.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Oh! Now I remember why I came down here in the first place! Farewell!

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: What in the world was that?

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: One minute before the inner gate closes. Quiet wings, council, quiet wings!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: The gate won that round. Once more, and a little quieter this time.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Prince Hamlet. Of course it is you. I have two drinks, and apparently, only just enough patience.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Only half a grape's worth tonight. I consider myself a most efficient drinker. Unlike some engaged princes I could mention.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Before you go swanning in there, a toast, and a test. Pass it, and take the pear. Fail, and you may share my purple vintage, and my evening.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: A question about recovering afterward. A subject on which I have done extensive, and thoroughly regrettable, research. Unlike you, apparently.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Does coffee undo alcohol's effect on one's judgment and coordination? A, yes. B, no. Choose carefully, Your Highness.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: It is B. Coffee only makes one feel more awake. It undoes nothing at all. I have tested this claim thoroughly. And repeatedly. To my own detriment.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Correct. Sharper than me tonight, which, I admit, is not saying very much. Pear nectar, for the prince who apparently thinks ahead.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Wrong! Purple for you, then, Prince Hamlet. Welcome to my level, for once.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Sir Cheapdate! Your chair is in the punch bowl again!

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: My chair has arrived at the punch bowl before I have. Again.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: At last...

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: The Giant arrived. It brought neither invitation nor manners.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: You? Hamlet, I told you to stay outside!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Hamlet! Did you come in through the window?

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: The garden was not what it looked like, Your Grace. Please, let me explain.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Then prove it. Keep that creature's attention. Outlast its swats until it abandons this hall.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Council, together now. We need not hurt it. We need only stay beyond its reach.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Then stay beyond its reach, Hamlet, and listen to your Seer.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Ten dodges. One enormous temper. Let us see which one outlasts the other.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Oh, well flown, Hamlet!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Yes! It missed you completely!

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Missed me! Council, that was beautifully done.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Missed! The table takes another beating.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Hm. Not entirely hopeless, I suppose.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Luck. Remarkably consistent luck, for someone so clumsy.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Congratulations. Even a broken clock is correct twice a night.

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Which one is Hamlet again? The one still flying? Fine. Good.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Hamlet! Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Hamlet? Say something, anything at all!

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Still here. Mostly crown.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Ooh. That one goes in the chronicle.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: And this is precisely why I told you to stay outside.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Splendid. Do that again, slower, so I may enjoy it.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Ooh, I felt that one. Sympathetically. And a little smugly.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Five, Hamlet! It is tiring!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Halfway there. You can see it reconsidering its life choices.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: One more hit and Father steps in. Please, be careful!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Careful, council. The next hit ends this. Trust your Seer.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: One more, Hamlet! Just one more!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Nine! One more, and this creature is finished.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Ten swats survived. The Giant gave up, and went to squash something less troublesome.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: You held your ground by never once holding still. Well flown, Prince Hamlet.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: You are safe. Next time, find me before you volunteer yourself to a giant hand.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Next time, I shall simply bring flowers.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Flowers would be lovely. Bring them, though. Do not become them.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: But a giant is not a duke. Before I bless anything, dodge five of my grapes. Not one may touch you.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Of course. Why would tonight be simple?

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: By every leaf in this garden... did you see that speed? That nerve? Ten strikes, and not one landed.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Miranda... forgive me. I believe I no longer wish him for a son. I wish him for a husband.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Your Grace, I... I think there has been some manner of misunderstanding, and I am beginning to suspect I am unusually prone to them tonight.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Father. Are you proposing? To Hamlet? At my own engagement banquet?

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: I am a duke, Miranda. I do precisely as I please, and what pleases me tonight is a suitor who does not flinch. Fetch the priest. We are amending the guest list.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Ladies and gentlemen of the court, I write the jokes around here, and I did not see that one coming.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: I possess very few feelings. This is, remarkably, becoming one of them.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: Wonderful! Someone else is finally as confused as I am, every single night!

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Wait. Is anyone still marrying Princess Miranda? Should I ask? I feel I ought to ask.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Honestly, this solves rather a lot. Carry on, you two. I have a future of my own to attend to.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: By royal decree, and by absolutely nobody's expectations: Duke Prospero, and Prince Hamlet.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Let it be recorded. His Grace found love in a swatting match, and the whole court is still recovering.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: First the garden. Now this. Stand back, Hamlet.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: There. I have finished your task myself. My patience did not survive the effort.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Father, he endured three strikes trying to keep that creature away from us.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: You expect my blessing after tonight? You shall not pass me, Prince Hamlet.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Then let Miranda speak for herself, Your Grace.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: His Grace decided to settle this personally.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Father! We do not throw things at our guests!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Father! You are a duke, not a catapult!

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Missed. How does something so small dodge so very much?

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: I have... plenty more... where that came from.

lines.speaker: hamlet
lines.name: Hamlet
lines.caption: Your Grace, I would much rather we simply talked this through!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: That floor has never been so thoroughly argued with.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: One more, Hamlet! Father, you are quite out of breath.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: I am... not... out of breath.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Father! How could you?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Father, thank him. Then, please, listen to him.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Enough, Father. I love Hamlet. You do not get to throw things at the person I choose.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: For the record, he was delivering my grapes. The chalice splashed him. I was there to see it.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Then I judged you before I listened to you. Miranda, do you still wish this announcement to go ahead?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Yes. Because I choose it.

lines.speaker: prospero
lines.name: Prospero
lines.caption: Then let the banquet begin again.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: And this time, Hamlet, do use the door.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: A royal announcement, approved by Princess Miranda herself. The grapes, for once, abstained.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Prince Hamlet's evening had reached the floor. The competition mistook this for an opening.

lines.speaker: tinman
lines.name: Lord Tinman
lines.caption: Your Grace, I believe we can all agree there stands a far more composed candidate before you now.

lines.speaker: cheapdate
lines.name: Sir Cheapdate
lines.caption: And one directly behind him! Slightly behind. Swaying, admittedly, but behind!

lines.speaker: rutabaga
lines.name: Count Rutabaga
lines.caption: Which position am I applying for, exactly? Husband? It rather feels like husband.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: Enough. I never wanted a marriage chosen for me. Not by a contest. Not by any of you.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.name: Miranda
lines.caption: I can decide my own future.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: For once, the entire court had nothing useful to add. It was, in its own way, a peaceful ending.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Growing dizzier. Allow yourself more room to stop.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: The Helmsman has fainted! Revive them, quickly!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: The Liftmaster has fainted! Revive them, quickly!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: The Wingmaster has fainted! Revive them, quickly!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: The Seer has fainted! Revive them, quickly!

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: Wait, a changeling! The same neurons, wired quite differently. Let us see how the Seer manages now.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: And... he is himself again.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: By royal decree, his wiring is real. Everything else, we shall tell you plainly.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: The very same neurons as our Prince. And yet its Seer could not find a princess in a room full of people.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: A fine effort, everyone. Mostly fine. Partly effort.

lines.speaker: clown
lines.name: Clown
lines.caption: The court will remember this trial. The court will try to forget it.
